history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that requisitioning departments, in consultation with the Procurement Division, take steps to improve monitoring of contract delivery and ensure that contracts awarded are completed before their expiry.
history.administration_response: The Office of Central Support Services will continue to encourage requisitioning departments to ensure that contract management training is undertaken by all relevant staff. It should be noted, however, that the majority of the cases cited by the Board are for services that are used on an “as needed” basis and that pose no risk to the Organization if they are not utilized. The Office of Human Resources Management stated it was reviewing the feasibility of making this programme mandatory for the staff members with contract management responsibilities in the United Nations Secretariat. The review was expected to be completed by the fourth quarter of 2017.
history.board_assessment: The Board takes note of the comment. Since the improvement of contract management is also included in the recommendation of its report contained in document A/70/5 (Vol. I) for the year ended 31 December 2014, para. 142, the recommendation is treated as overtaken by events.
